parameters.name: clientToken
parameters.description: A client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. The value is generated by the client and must be unique among different requests. The maximum length is 64 ASCII characters.

parameters.name: force
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to forcefully restart the instance. Valid values:

- true: forcefully restarts the instance.
- false (default): does not forcefully restart the instance.
